input: # Inputs the Zig 0.16.0 reference implementation REJECTS. Every verdict here
# was taken from `std.zig.Ast` + `std.zig.ZonGen` via the oracle in
# scripts/fetch-zigzon.sh, not decided by this parser.
# An empty fraction needs a COMPLETE exponent after it: zig reads `1.e3` as
# one float token and rejects each of these.
# A `\u{...}` escape in an IDENTIFIER must name a Unicode scalar value, so the
# surrogate block is rejected. A CHARACTER literal is an integer in Zig and
# A raw control character is not an identifier character either.
# A `"..."` literal takes Zig's escape set and no other: the relaxed-JSON
# escapes are rejected, a `\u{...}` must name a Unicode scalar value (so the
# surrogate block is out, paired or not), and a raw control character is not
# `\0` is not a Zig escape; `'\x00'` and `'\u{0}'` are (see chars.tsv).
